items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: You had a singer with your band at one point called Herman Higgs?

ctx.x: No, that was the name of the club. We just called it that 'cause we played over there, I think, Saturdays and Sundays. But that was originally what we called "Seven Pods of Pepper."
You had a singer with your band at one point called Herman Higgs?
